items.title: Code-based prototyping: When it's worth the setup
items.excerpt: Eleken's head of design explains why the agency now prototypes with real components, including Claude-generated interactive dashboards, to test states and edge cases that static Figma mockups hide.
items.rationale: A design agency's practical account of when to prototype in code with Claude-generated components instead of static Figma mockups. Teams can apply it on their next project.
